camera_pose_anchor.method: orientation chordal rotation, positive LS center-baseline scale, mean center translation; no pointmap or surface GT fit

protocol.raw_definition: Unmodified cached Omega depth + decoded predicted intrinsics/extrinsics; backproject with beta=1. No world_points head exists in these caches.
protocol.primary_alignment: Depth: one RAW FIT median GT/Z scale. 3D: common camera-pose-only Sim(3), no surface fitting; same transform across all arms
protocol.sensitivity_alignment: RAW FIT and previously frozen FoV FIT Sim(3), each shared across all arms; replay old results
protocol.evaluation: Frozen previous valid GT and I0 validation, identical IDs for every arm; no shift in depth
protocol.evaluation_annotation: Post-hoc baseline extension; existing Kinect/FARO GT reused; no GT reconstruction optimization

GT_sensor: FARO Focus X330 laser scanner; official occlusion-aware rendered depth
